entries.speaker: Cute Announcer
entries.en: And now, onto the "Hottest Meet-and-[n]Greet" segment of our show...

entries.speaker: Cute Announcer
entries.en: After his last appearance was so well-[n]received, we decided to bring back[n]this fine gentleman today.

entries.speaker: Cute Announcer
entries.en: It's the high school detective,[n]Goro Akechi!

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: This tastes a bit bland...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: But I'm relieved. A lot's happened, but[n]it seems your grades haven't dropped.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: School's been going fine.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm more worried about you, Sis. Are you[n]tired? You're probably lacking sodium.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Do I seem so?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But hypothetically speaking, if these[n]Phantom Thieves are real...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I believe they should be tried in a court[n]of law.

entries.speaker: Cheerful Host
entries.en: That's quite the statement. Are they[n]committing crimes?

entries.speaker: Cheerful Host
entries.en: Some people even say that the Thieves[n]are actually helping their victims[n]abandon their evil ways.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: What the artist Madarame did truly was[n]an unforgivable crime.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: However, they are taking the law into[n]their own hands by judging him. It is far[n]from justice.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: More importantly, you should never forcefully[n]change a person's heart.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Is it a crime to manipulate someone's[n]heart?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Depending on the means, yes.[n]He's absolutely right.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Even if it makes someone admit their[n]evil deeds and helps make them pay[n]for their crimes?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Why the sudden interest?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's nothing...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Do you believe that these "allies of[n]justice" exist?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Of course not.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: You don't need to think about such[n]unnecessary things.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...You understand what I'm trying to say,[n]right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Study hard and go to a prestigious[n]college...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Moving up in the world is difficult as[n]a woman. Yet, you can't do much if[n]you don't have the authority.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I'll use every method necessary to make[n]it happen.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: All you need to do is remain focused on[n]what must be done now for your future's[n]sake.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Sorry.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: *sigh* Now?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Yes? ...Mm-hm, it's fine.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Oh, that case.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What must be done...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Justice...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If those Phantom Thieves are out[n]there helpin' people... I'd root for 'em,[n]no questions asked.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What do I want to do?
